findings.title: Denial-cache keys collide for valid resource and folder UIDs
findings.body: The key concatenates `name` and `parent` using an unescaped `_` delimiter, so distinct checks can produce the same key when UIDs contain underscores. For example, a denial for name `a_b` in parent `c` has the same key as a denial for name `a` in parent `b_c` for the same namespace, user, and action. Dashboard and folder UIDs may contain underscores, so a cached denial for one resource/folder combination can incorrectly deny access to another combination for the cache TTL. Encode each component unambiguously (for example, length-prefix/JSON/hash structured fields) before constructing the key.
